title: Paper-Tried Entry (v2, config-aware)
description: One row per attempted method, appended to projects/NN/state/paper_tried.jsonl. v2 dedup key is (method_id, config_fingerprint), not method alone.

method_id.description: Stable canonical method name (e.g. 'au_8node_graph'). Same method across configs shares this id.

config_fingerprint.description: SHA hash of the canonical sorted-key config dict. Dedup key together with method_id.

config_summary.description: Human-readable subset of the config — for debugging; not used for dedup

retryable_with_changes.description: Names of config knobs that, if changed, justify a retry

method_globally_blocked.description: Only humans set this to true. Once true, no config retry permitted.

supersedes.description: If this entry corrects/updates a prior one, reference its timestamp+method_id key
